## Pettenedda (CR 5)

This fearsome hag garbed in rough woolens rakes awful foot-long clawed black fingernails through an immense mane of long, tangled black hair stretching down to her knees.  

**XP** 1,600  
NE Medium monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft; Perception +13  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +6 natural)  
**hp** 52 (7d10+14)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +7, **Will** +8  
**Resist** cold 5; **SR** 16; **Weaknesses** self-loathing  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 20 ft., swim 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +11 (1d4+3 plus bleed)  
**Special Attacks** captivating, bleed (1d6)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 7th, concentration +10)  


At will—hidden presence (DC 15)  

3/day—suggestion (DC 16)  

1/day—bestow curse (DC 16)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 17, **Dex** 15, **Con** 14, **Int** 12, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +10; **CMD** 22  
**Feats** Combat Casting, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Bluff), Weapon Focus (claw)  
**Skills** Bluff +16, Climb +11, Perception +13, Sense Motive +13, Stealth +12, Swim +20  
**Languages** Common, Giant  
**SQ** amphibious, hair effigy  


**Special Abilities**



**Captivating (Su)** By brushing one of her claws through her hair, a pettenedda can captivate listeners with the sound of running water. All listeners within a 60-foot spread must succeed on a DC 15 Will saving throw or become captivated. A creature that successfully saves is not subject to the same pettenedda’s ability for 24 hours. A victim who is captivated moves toward the petteneda using the most direct means available. If the path leads them into a dangerous area such as through fire or off a cliff, the creature receives a second saving throw to end the effect before moving into peril. Captivated creatures can take no actions other than to defend themselves. A victim within 5 feet of the pettenedda offers no resistance to her attacks. The pettenedda may maintain this effect with a move action. This is a sonic mind-affecting charm effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Hair Effigy (Su)** A pettenedda can cut some of her hair and spend 1 minute braiding and tying it into the form of a small doll, bracelet, or other decorative thing. A creature possessing a hair effigy adds a +1 luck bonus on all d20 rolls. Any creatures except a hag within 30 feet of the possessor take a -1 penalty on all d20 rolls.
